description: User uploads a photo of the driving licence and/or pastes contact text. AI proposes the driver form fields. Nothing is saved automatically and the AI never verifies a driver.
privacy: Licence photos contain personal data and are sent to the configured AI provider. Aadhaar-like numbers found in pasted text are redacted before sending. Aadhaar and PAN are never extracted. Disable the whole module with ASSIST_ENABLE_DRIVER_DOCUMENTS=false.

fields.label: Driving licence number
fields.note: Returned compact uppercase, e.g. MH1220190001234; always 'confirm'

fields.label: Licence type
fields.note: Mapped from the printed class (LMV, HMV, HGMV, TRANS...); always 'confirm'

fields.label: Licence validity date
fields.note: Transport (TR) validity is used for commercial licences

fields.label: Phone (10-digit Indian mobile)
fields.note: From pasted text only, and must be written in it

fields.label: Aadhaar number / document
fields.reason: Sensitive government id: never sent to or returned by the AI

fields.label: PAN number
fields.reason: Sensitive government id: not extracted by the AI

fields.label: Experience years
fields.reason: Cannot be read from a licence; also note your schema default of 5 can mislead
